bait_content.title: Filesystem Watch Limit Reached
bait_content.body: The system has hit the inotify watch limit (fs.inotify.max_user_watches). Real-time file change monitoring is paused for some apps, including web browsers and sync clients. Increase the limit or close applications to restore live updates.
